questions.question: A Levite's concubine left him and went back to her father's house in Bethlehem. Why did he travel there after her?

answers.text: To speak kindly to her and bring her back
To demand payment from her father
To bring her before the town elders

Wicked men of Gibeah demanded that an old man hand over his guest, a Levite. What reason did the old man give for refusing?

answers.text: The man was a guest in his house
The man was a priest of the LORD
The man had done nothing wrong
